name: Cloudflare: WAF top blocked client IPs
description: Every 15 minutes, asks the GraphQL Analytics API which client IPs a zone's security features blocked or challenged most since the previous run, and creates one pending alert per IP at or above a request threshold (source cloudflare-waf).

params.label: Zone ID
params.help: 32-character zone ID (zone Overview page, API section). Install the template once per zone.

params.label: Minimum blocked/challenged requests per IP
params.help: Whole number. An IP with fewer blocked or challenged requests in one window raises no alert. Severity: 10x the threshold or more = high, 3x = medium, else low.

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: Cloudflare API token (sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`) with **Zone > Analytics > Read** on this zone.

setup:
## Cloudflare side
1. My Profile > API Tokens > **Create Token** > Custom token. Permission **Zone > Analytics > Read** (API name *Analytics Read*), zone resources: this zone (or all zones). The other Cloudflare templates can share one token if it also has their permissions.
2. Store it as `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN`, allowed host `api.cloudflare.com`.

## How it works
- `POST https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/graphql` with JSON `{query, variables}`: dataset `firewallEventsAdaptiveGroups` for the zone, `filter: {datetime_geq: start, datetime_lt: end, action_in: [block, challenge, js_challenge, managed_challenge]}`, grouped by `clientIP` (with `clientCountryName`, `clientAsn`, `clientASNDescription`), `orderBy: [count_DESC]`, `limit: 100`.
- Window: from the previous successful run to this run, both shifted 5 minutes back so late-indexed events are still counted once. The start is clamped to at most **6 hours** before the end (see Limits).
- Groups with `count` >= `MIN_EVENTS` become alerts. External id `<zone id>:<client IP>:<window start>`, so the same IP can raise a new alert in a later window but a re-read window never duplicates. Title `Cloudflare WAF: <count> blocked/challenged requests from <ip> (<country>)`; payload = the group (`count`, `dimensions`). Severity: `count` >= 10 x threshold high, >= 3 x medium, otherwise low.
- A non-200 answer or a GraphQL `errors` array (Cloudflare reports query errors with HTTP 200 too) fails the run with the HTTP status only; the next run re-reads the window.

## Limits
- ponytail: one query per run, top **100** IPs by count; lower-ranked IPs over the threshold in a very noisy window are not alerted.
- ponytail: window ceiling 6 h. Each plan sets a maximum time range per query for this dataset (`settings { firewallEventsAdaptiveGroups { maxDuration } }`); 6 h stays under it. After a longer outage only the last 6 h are counted.
- `count` is Cloudflare's adaptive-sampling estimate (sum of sample intervals), not an exact request count.
- Adaptive datasets keep at least 31 days on every plan; the GraphQL API allows 300 queries per 5 minutes per user (one per run here).

Docs: [GraphQL Analytics API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/analytics/graphql-api/), [Querying firewall events](https://developers.cloudflare.com/analytics/graphql-api/tutorials/querying-firewall-events/), [Limits](https://developers.cloudflare.com/analytics/graphql-api/limits/), [Settings node](https://developers.cloudflare.com/analytics/graphql-api/features/discovery/settings/), [Errors](https://developers.cloudflare.com/analytics/graphql-api/errors/), [Token permissions](https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/reference/permissions/).

body.query: query WafTopClientIPs($zoneTag: string, $start: Time, $end: Time) { viewer { zones(filter: {zoneTag: $zoneTag}) { firewallEventsAdaptiveGroups(filter: {datetime_geq: $start, datetime_lt: $end, action_in: ["block", "challenge", "js_challenge", "managed_challenge"]}, limit: 100, orderBy: [count_DESC]) { count dimensions { clientIP clientCountryName clientAsn clientASNDescription } } } } }

config.expression: steps.pull.output.status == 200 and steps.pull.output.body is mapping and not steps.pull.output.body.get('errors') and (((steps.pull.output.body.get('data') or {}).get('viewer') or {}).get('zones') or []) | length == 1

config.message: Cloudflare WAF pull failed: HTTP {{ steps.pull.output.status }}{{ ' (GraphQL errors)' if steps.pull.output.status == 200 and steps.pull.output.body is mapping and steps.pull.output.body.get('errors') else '' }}

config.external_id: %%ZONE_ID%%:{{ loop.item.dimensions.clientIP }}:{%- macro ep(s) -%}{%- set mo = s[5:7]|int -%}{%- set y = (s[0:4]|int) - (1 if mo <= 2 else 0) -%}{%- set era = y // 400 -%}{%- set yoe = y - era * 400 -%}{%- set doe = yoe * 365 + yoe // 4 - yoe // 100 + (153 * (mo + (-3 if mo > 2 else 9)) + 2) // 5 + (s[8:10]|int) - 1 -%}{{ ((era * 146097 + doe - 719468) * 86400 + (s[11:13]|int) * 3600 + (s[14:16]|int) * 60 + (s[17:19]|int)) }}{%- endmacro -%}{%- macro iso(e) -%}{%- set days = e // 86400 -%}{%- set secs = e - days * 86400 -%}{%- set z = days + 719468 -%}{%- set era = z // 146097 -%}{%- set doe = z - era * 146097 -%}{%- set yoe = (doe - doe // 1460 + doe // 36524 - doe // 146096) // 365 -%}{%- set doy = doe - (365 * yoe + yoe // 4 - yoe // 100) -%}{%- set mp = (5 * doy + 2) // 153 -%}{%- set d = doy - (153 * mp + 2) // 5 + 1 -%}{%- set m = mp + (3 if mp < 10 else -9) -%}{%- set y = yoe + era * 400 + (1 if m <= 2 else 0) -%}{{ '%04d-%02d-%02dT%02d:%02d:%02dZ' | format(y, m, d, secs // 3600, (secs % 3600) // 60, secs % 60) }}{%- endmacro -%}{{ iso([ep(trigger.since)|int - 300, ep(trigger.fired_at)|int - 300 - 21600] | max) }}
config.title: Cloudflare WAF: {{ loop.item.count }} blocked/challenged requests from {{ loop.item.dimensions.clientIP }} ({{ loop.item.dimensions.get('clientCountryName') or 'unknown country' }})
config.severity: {{ 'high' if loop.item.count >= 10 * ('%%MIN_EVENTS%%' | int) else ('medium' if loop.item.count >= 3 * ('%%MIN_EVENTS%%' | int) else 'low') }}
